method: Human visual cross-check of original PDF pages 16, 29, 41, 50 and 55; correct generated transcription, no fault ground truth.
generation_rules: 원본 대조로 확인한 냉각수 회로: p29 M45는 쿨런트 건 펌프 모터 0.4kW, QM45는 모터 보호기(2.5A 표기), KM45는 접촉기, ZM45는 모터가 아닌 보호/서지 억제 요소이다. p16 Y0.5 CGUN.R의 태그는 KM45. p41 Y0.5에 해당하는 KAR06 출력 접점(COM2-R6)과 QM45 보조접점23-24가 KM45 코일 A1 회로에 있고 A2는 L000이다. KM45A는 배선명이며 별도 접촉기가 아니다. M44는 플러싱 모터1.5kW, QM44는 보호기(8.0A), KM44는 접촉기, Y0.4 MFOM.R/KAR05와 QM44 보조접점23-24가 KM44 코일 회로에 있다. 이 확인 사실과 어긋나는 자동 판독 기록은 사용하지 않는다. 전압·접지저항·절연저항·정상 ON/OFF 극성을 근거 없이 만들지 않는다. 관련 없는 신호는 나열하지 않는다. 안전 조건이 없는 통전 계측 지시는 쓰지 않는다. 1200자 이내로 연결과 점검 대상을 간결하게 쓰고 실제 고장 원인은 확정하지 않는다.

devices.description: COOLANT GUN PUMP MOTOR, three-phase motor, 0.4kW; power through QM45 and KM45. ZM45 is not the motor.
Motor protection circuit breaker, printed 2.5A; power to KM45 and M45. Auxiliary 23-24 in KM45 coil circuit on p41.
Contactor switching three-phase power to coolant gun pump motor M45; power contacts 1-2,3-4,5-6; coil circuit on p41.
서지 억제 소자(스파크 킬러), M45 전원선의 보호 요소. Surge suppression element, not a motor. 부품 형식과 정격은 미확인.
Motor protector auxiliary contact 23-24 in series with KM45 coil A1; not a relay coil. Main power circuit p29. 보조접점의 과부하·트립 시 개폐 동작은 이번 원본 대조에서 확인하지 않았다.
Coolant gun contactor coil A1: L110 via KB1/KAR06 COM2-R6 (Y0.5), then QM45 auxiliary23-24; A2 to L000. KM45A is wire label, not device.
Relay output contact COM2-R6 associated with PLC output Y0.5, feeds KM45 coil circuit through QM45 auxiliary23-24.
Suppression element across KM45 contactor coil A1/A2; no rating/model verified.
MACHINE FLUSHING COOLANT PUMP MOTOR, three-phase motor, 1.5kW; power via QM44 and KM44.
Motor protection circuit breaker, printed8.0A; power to KM44 and M44; auxiliary23-24 in KM44 coil circuit p41.
Contactor switching three-phase power to machine flushing coolant motor M44; coil circuit on p41.
서지 억제 소자(스파크 킬러), M44 전원선의 보호 요소. Surge suppression element, not a motor.
Motor protector auxiliary contact23-24 in series with KM44 coil A1; main power circuit p29. 보조접점의 과부하·트립 시 개폐 동작은 이번 원본 대조에서 확인하지 않았다.
Machine flushing contactor coil A1: L110 via KB1/KAR05 COM2-R5 (Y0.4), then QM44 auxiliary23-24; A2 to L000. KM44A is wire label.
Relay output contact COM2-R5 associated with PLC output Y0.4, feeds KM44 coil through QM44 auxiliary23-24.
Y2,Z2-axis servo amplifier S.V.M-2. On this Y2-axis page its motor power runs through WJ12V2/XJ12V2 to M12V2; pulse-coder path from JF1/XJF1Y2 uses WJ12F2 and XJ12F2 to AV12F2.
Y2-axis main servo motor. Power through WJ12V2 cable and XJ12V2 motor connector from AV14. AV12F2 serial pulse coder is installed in the motor. M12VA2 is a separate fan motor.
FAN MOTOR, separate from the M12V2 main servo motor. Fan supply uses WJ12VA2 cable and XJ12VA2 connector. XJ12VA2 is not the amplifier or pulse-coder connector.
Serial pulse coder installed in Y2 servo motor; links to AV14 amplifier JF1/XJF1Y2 through WJ12F2 cable and XJ12F2 connector. XT11 is not this pulse-coder connection.
Main Y2 motor power cable from AV14 amplifier to XJ12V2 connector and M12V2 motor; separate from pulse-coder cable WJ12F2.
Serial pulse-coder cable between AV14 amplifier JF1/XJF1Y2 and XJ12F2 connector to motor-installed AV12F2 coder; not motor power cable WJ12V2.
Connector for M12VA2 fan motor via WJ12VA2; not the main motor connector XJ12V2 or pulse-coder connector XJ12F2.
Terminals SM and Y22 for Y12V2 brake circuit via WJ12H2/XJ12H2; ZK23 suppression element across these lines. Not the serial pulse-coder circuit.

Separate detector interface unit for external axis glass scale, WITHOUT AMPLIFIER TYPE; printed usage table assigns Y2 to A52 JF101. This external glass-scale feedback is distinct from the motor-installed serial pulse coder AV12F2 on p50.
Y2 AXIS GLASS SCALE WIRE for separate detector feedback to A52 JF101 in printed usage table. Distinct from WJ12F2 motor serial pulse-coder cable and WJ12V2 motor power on p50.
